scope: Mask-indexed bounce-back comparison, with a vivsim rule port and an analytic Poiseuille reference. The archived result contains identity, channel and timing data. The fresh CPU check covers only the identity block.

H1.threshold: == 0.0 (bitwise; a representation change must be exact)

H2.metric: max |A2 - A4|_inf on a body-force channel after 1500 steps, run twice (g=0 and g=1e-5)
H2.threshold: g=0: == 0.0 (bitwise); g>0: <= 1e-4 absolute on populations of order 0.1 (deviation is reported, not tuned)

H3.threshold: |err| < 15% (owner band) at every H, and |err| < 1% for H >= 16; monotone decrease of |err| with H is reported but NOT required to pass (the previous verified case showed non-monotone behaviour and it is kept visible)

H4.metric: err_pct_if_H_eq_ny at the same H sweep
H4.threshold: reported as a trap; predicted |err| ~ (ny/H)^2 - 1 -> 12% at H=8, 3% at H=32 (checked, not tuned)

H5.metric: wall time per application on a 512x512 float64 field, solid fraction in {0.005,0.02,0.05,0.10,0.25,0.50}
H5.threshold: speedup >= 1.5x vs dense where at solid fraction <= 0.10; speedup is reported for all fractions (both crossings reported)

H6.metric: |err Cd| (%) for D in {16, 24} against the in-repo anchor ref_cd = 5.57953523384 (benchmarks/verified/cylinder/re20_st/result.json)
H6.threshold: owner band 15% applies to each arm; the *comparison* is reported as the adoption trade-off (no threshold invented to force a winner)
